title: Round House
statementMd:
Vasya lives in a round building, whose entrances are numbered sequentially by integers from $1$ to $*n*$. Entrance $*n*$ and entrance $1$ are adjacent.

Today Vasya got bored and decided to take a walk in the yard. Vasya lives in entrance $*a*$ and he decided that during his walk he will move around the house $*b*$ entrances in the direction of increasing numbers (in this order entrance $*n*$ should be followed by entrance $1$). The negative value of $*b*$ corresponds to moving $|*b*|$ entrances in the order of decreasing numbers (in this order entrance $1$ is followed by entrance $*n*$). If $*b* = 0$, then Vasya prefers to walk beside his entrance.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9fcaffa32cbd86f4e151dbe8918d2c3feca51efb.png) Illustration for $*n* = 6$, $*a* = 2$, $*b* = - 5$.

Help Vasya to determine the number of the entrance, near which he will be at the end of his walk.

## Input

The single line of the input contains three space-separated integers $*n*$, $*a*$ and $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100, 1 ≤ *a* ≤ *n*,  - 100 ≤ *b* ≤ 100$) — the number of entrances at Vasya's place, the number of his entrance and the length of his walk, respectively.

## Output

Print a single integer $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$) — the number of the entrance where Vasya will be at the end of his walk.

## Note

The first example is illustrated by the picture in the statements.
statementZhMd:
Vasya 住在一栋圆形建筑中，建筑的入口按顺序编号为从 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的整数。入口 $*n*$ 与入口 $1$ 相邻。

今天 Vasya 感到无聊，于是决定到院子里散步。Vasya 住在入口 $*a*$，他决定在散步过程中沿着编号递增的方向绕房屋走过 $*b*$ 个入口（按照此顺序，入口 $*n*$ 的下一个入口是入口 $1$）。$*b*$ 的负值表示沿着编号递减的顺序走过 $|*b*|$ 个入口（按照此顺序，入口 $1$ 的下一个入口是入口 $*n*$）。如果 $*b* = 0$，那么 Vasya 更愿意在自己的入口旁边散步。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9fcaffa32cbd86f4e151dbe8918d2c3feca51efb.png) $*n* = 6$、$*a* = 2$、$*b* = - 5$ 时的示意图。

请帮助 Vasya 确定散步结束时他所在入口的编号。

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含三个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$、$*a*$ 和 $*b*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100, 1 ≤ *a* ≤ *n*,  - 100 ≤ *b* ≤ 100$）——Vasya 所在建筑的入口数量、他的入口编号以及他散步的长度。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$）——Vasya 散步结束时所在入口的编号。

## 说明

第一个样例由题面中的图片展示。
